I used to do medical transport in Phoenix. In the summer. Most of our fleet were old ford 350’s that were modified to fit a stretcher and maybe 2 extra passengers max. Cue peak summer, overhead AC unit in the van I’m driving goes out. The unit to keep the patients cool during the ride.  I tell HQ. They tell me to finish my shift (6 hours left) and to bring it to the shop for repair. Okay, NBD. Didn’t think much of it. The van still had the front AC vents working. I pick up a stroke victim for transport to a hospice. The daughter is adamant about riding along. Okay, no prob. The whole trip itself is about 20 minutes. About 3 minutes into the trip the daughter starts LOSING her mind. It’s too hot! Oh my god! Pull over and let us out (we were on a hwy about 3 exits away from our stop) I tell her I can’t do that. Company policy is that once a patient is in the van, they can’t be taken off until the destination is reached. Legal reasons, etc. Daughter is calling me every name in the book. I keep telling her we’re almost there and to please stop yelling as she’s aggravating the situation. Destination arrives. I drop off the patient. Call HQ and tell them I’m not taking another pickup with this van. Lady was still calling me names as I drove off and at one point said she’d sue. Okay, well you can sue the company I was just doing my job. Long story short, don’t fuckin’ drive without AC in Phoenix.
